name: Operators
description: DSL operator registry — source of truth for token mapping and catalog display.

tokens.description: Transforms a source document using a projection definition. Maps source fields to target field paths.
Validates a source document against a projection definition. Produces a field-by-field audit JSON and an HTML review with Save and Save & Resolve buttons.

params.name: tableName
params.description: Target [cases] table name — enables Save & Resolve button

params.name: srcDocId
params.description: Original source document id — shown as link in review

tokens.description: Applies a billing rule to a projected document. Evaluates NCalc expressions to compute derived fields (e.g. units, charge amount).
tokens.algebraExample: (R)  →  A(P)B(R)C  — project A through B then apply rule C

tokens.description: Builds a HIPAA 837P claim from session, case, coverage, authorization, diagnoses, provider, and assessment data. Produces claim JSON and HTML review doc.

params.name: caseId
params.description: CaseId to pull claim data for

params.name: sessionId
params.description: SessionId to pull claim data for

tokens.description: Resolves a JSON document into a [cases] domain table row using the field mapping for that table. The SP handles insert/update logic.
tokens.algebraExample: (D)  →  A(D)  — resolve A into domain table

tokens.description: Packages any number of input documents into a single ZIP archive.
tokens.algebraExample: (Z)  →  (Z)[A,B,C]  — bundle A, B, C into archive

tokens.description: Field-level override merge. Source fields replace matching target fields recursively. Unmatched target fields are preserved. Creates a new document.
tokens.algebraExample: (M)  →  A(M)B  — A fields merged into B, A overrides

tokens.description: Smart accumulate-merge. Numbers add, arrays find-or-append by sessionId/documentId/id, objects deep-merge. Recalculates 837P CLM02 and renumbers LX01. Creates a new document.
tokens.algebraExample: (AM)  →  A(AM)B  — A accumulated into B (numbers add, arrays append)

tokens.description: Renders a boxes-format doc as a self-contained CMS-1500 HTML review page.
tokens.algebraExample: (X)  →  A(X)  — render A as CMS-1500 HTML

tokens.description: Applies the 837P billing rule to an assembled claim. Loads session and authorization documents from metadata, builds Loop 2400 service lines, calculates units and amounts, computes CLM02, and validates the claim.
tokens.algebraExample: (Q)  →  A(Q)B  — apply rule B to claim A

tokens.description: Serializes a source 837P document to an X12 text artifact with an .edi.txt filename based on the source document id.
tokens.algebraExample: (W)  →  A(W)  — serialize A as X12 text

tokens.description: Shortens a URL. No chained doc input — url/lifetime come from --url/--lifetime. Saves a {shortUrl} doc and echoes the /s/{id} link to console.

params.name: lifetime
params.description: Hours until the short link expires; omit for no expiration

tokens.algebraExample: (S)  →  (S)  — shorten a URL from context params
